nodes.rationale: Mirrors the BOM sheet to bom_costs.json on every successful run, same pattern as offers_prices.json, used as offline fallback when the sheet is unreachable so the generator can still run.

nodes.label: Pricing rule — two tiers (BAND cost cutoff) + hand pins
nodes.norm_label: pricing rule — two tiers (band cost cutoff) + hand pins
nodes.rationale: Cost <= 900 -> KES 1,000, else KES 1,500. Mid-range bags (~700-900 BOM cost) are pinned by hand in reject_overrides.json because whether a bag sells at 1,000 or 1,500 is a desirability call, not a pure cost call.

nodes.label: minPrice / maxPrice config option (price-band isolation)
nodes.rationale: A cruder isolation than nameLike, superseded for Kitengela once the [REJECT] tag was found; still available for price-banded offers.

nodes.label: nameLike config option ([REJECT] tag filter)
nodes.rationale: The exact way to isolate a tagged range of Odoo products — Kitengela rejects are distinct Odoo products with [REJECT] in the name, so nameLike counts precisely those; supersedes the cruder minPrice/maxPrice price-band proxy.

nodes.label: "Other rejects" catch-all row (_OTHER_REJECTS)
nodes.rationale: _bucket maps a product to a listed bag by longest-prefix; unmatched [REJECT] units (colour/condition or plural/variant spelling mismatches) used to be silently dropped, under-counting the total (165 shown vs true count). Collected under one Other rejects row so headline TOTAL sold equals every reject sold.

nodes.label: Python-side bucketing vs ILIKE OR-chain optimization
nodes.norm_label: python-side bucketing vs ilike or-chain optimization
nodes.rationale: Fetches all bag products in scope and buckets in Python instead of OR-ing 60-70+ ILIKE patterns — about 3x faster on a month of Kenya sales.

nodes.rationale: Never use color decoratively — every color choice must carry semantic meaning (region colors also mapped: Kenya=green, Sinza=purple, Uganda=amber).

nodes.rationale: Bans generic AI design patterns (AI-purple gradients, three-pillar layouts, em-dashes, Lorem Ipsum, hand-rolled SVG icons) to keep UI from reading as templated/AI-generated.

nodes.label: Three AI-generated design clusters (calibration reference)
nodes.rationale: Named as defaults to avoid: warm cream + serif + terracotta; near-black + single acid-green/vermilion accent; broadsheet hairline-rule newspaper layout — legitimate for some briefs but defaults rather than deliberate choices.
